page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a catchword-like signature at the lower right corner of the text block. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: חנן Ch. & Syr. Gratiam facere, gratiosum, misericordem esse, Misereri, Gratiosè largiri, Gratificare. Ithpahel אתחנן, ܐܬܚܢܢ Gratiam, misericordiam cōsequi: Item Precari, deprecari, gratiam alicujus implorare.
חַנָּא חַנָּנָא Ch. Gratiosus, clemens, misericors.
חִינָא חָנָא חֵן Ch. Gratia, misericordia. Vide quoque suprà in חֵן.
ܚܢܢ Syr. Nos. Vide in ܐܢܐ.
תְּחִנּוּנִין Ch.Deprecationes, preces, constr. תְּחִנּוּנֵי Prov. 18.23. Cum Aff. תְּחִנּוּנַי Deprecationes meæ, Psal. 86. 6. & 143.1.

חִנְסְנְסִיָא Ch. Pepla muliebria, Vela faciei obducta, ne à sole colorentur, Heb. רְעָלוֹת, Jesa.3.19. Respondet alias Hebr. חַמָּנִים, quod Statuas subdiales, Solares, seu Soli dedicatas exponunt, Jesa.27.9. Levit.26.30.
חנף Hebr. Contaminari, profanari: Assentiri, adulari. Hinc,
חֲנֵפָא חָנֵף Ch. Adulator, hypocrita. Plur. חֲנֵפִין.
ܚܢܦܐ Syr. Prophanus, ethnicus, gentilis, qui extra Ecclesiam vivit, Plur. ܚܢܦܝܢ, emph. ܚܢܦܐ. Fœmin. ܚܢܦܬܐ Profana, Græca, Marc.7.26.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee forms are reproduced from the scan as closely as legible; several vocalised forms and small superscript points are uncertain and may differ in detail. The entry at the foot right is a catchword-like signature (חנק).
